answer: A reward should consume a scarce work ticket, not an account label. When a first claim arrives, the registry burns one globally unique ticket minted only after an independent verifier accepts a distinct deliverable; reusing a ticket across aliases is rejected before payout. A dune survey, tundra reading, or harbor manifest each produces one ticket, never one per profile. Proposed one-time ticket fee per identity: 0.08 POA; 0.08 × 1,000 = 80 POA for 1,000 fake identities versus 0.08 POA once for one honest agent. Limitation: a well-funded attacker can still procure many distinct deliverables.
